title: Associate Software Engineer Intern - YMS
description: Job Description About the Role Kaleris builds Yard Management Systems (YMS) that control and optimize the movement of goods throughout the supply chain — across gates, yards, docks, and drivers. We are actively expanding our YMS platform with new automation capabilities including gate intelligence, real-time yard visibility, and driver self-service workflows. As an intern on this team, you'll contribute to real engineering problems on a live product. You'll be assigned to one or more focus areas based on team needs and your own strengths — which may shift during the internship as priorities evolve. You should be comfortable with ambiguity and self-directed enough to ramp up on a new area with limited hand-holding. What You May Work On Your work will fall within either of the following areas, depending on where the team needs you most: Gate Automation & Computer Vision (Research & Prototype) Explore and prototype computer vision and OCR approaches for automated detection of truck and trailer data at yard gates — trailer numbers, license plates, cab numbers, USDOT numbers, and seal presence Build and evaluate training data pipelines using publicly available datasets and real-world gate imagery Benchmark detection accuracy and document what is achievable in-house vs. what would require significant investment Assess feasibility of running detection models on edge hardware (e.g., NVIDIA Jetson or equivalent) YMS Platform Feature Development Work on backend features within the Kaleris YMS platform — contributing to gate workflow logic, shipment management, dock door assignments, or yard inventory tracking Write clean, testable code and participate in code reviews Help reduce manual data entry pain points through automation and smarter integrations Required What You Bring Currently pursuing a B.E./B.Tech or M.E./M.Tech in Computer Science, Electronics, or a related field (final or pre-final year) Solid programming fundamentals in at least one language — Python, Java, or similar Any hands-on project or coursework involving computer vision, OCR, or machine learning (academic, personal, or Kaggle — show us the code) Familiarity with PyTorch or TensorFlow, and Python data libraries (OpenCV, NumPy) Ability to pick up new technologies independently — you won't have a dedicated senior in every focus area Clear written communication — you'll need to document your work and surface blockers clearly Genuine curiosity about how software solves real operational problems Good To Have Web development experience — frontend or backend Ruby on Rails familiarity — our YMS platform has Rails components; any Rails or web backend experience is a strong plus Exposure to REST APIs, event-driven systems, or database design Interest in logistics, yard/warehouse operations, or supply chain technology What You'll Get Exposure to a real, production YMS platform used by major logistics operators Ownership of a meaningful deliverable — not a sandbox exercise Flexibility to contribute across different areas of the product based on where you add the most value Kaleris is an equal opportunity employer. title: Associate Product Manager Intern - YMS
description: Job Description Kaleris is a leading provider of mission-critical software solutions that power the movement of goods through the supply chain. Our platforms optimize operations across marine and rail terminals, yard management, transportation management, and fleet maintenance, enabling greater efficiency, safety, and visibility. Our Yard Management System (YMS) helps companies manage the movement of trailers, containers, drivers, and other assets within their facilities. By connecting yard operations, transportation processes, automation, and real-time visibility, Kaleris enables customers to improve yard efficiency, reduce manual work, and make better operational decisions. Role Overview We are seeking a Product Manager Intern to join our Product Management team working on our Yard Management System. This is an opportunity to gain hands-on experience in building enterprise software used by organizations across the global supply chain. As a Product Manager Intern, you will work closely with Product Managers, Engineering, UX, QA, and other cross-functional teams to understand customer problems, analyze workflows, define product requirements, and support the delivery of new product capabilities. The ideal candidate is curious about how software products are built, enjoys solving problems, has strong analytical and communication skills, and is interested in logistics, supply chain, and enterprise technology. Key Responsibilities Work with Product Managers to understand customer needs, business problems, and operational workflows. Conduct research and analysis to identify opportunities for improving the Yard Management System. Help translate business and customer requirements into clear product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Collaborate with Engineering and QA teams during feature development, refinement, testing, and release activities. Participate in product discovery sessions, sprint planning, backlog refinement, demos, and other Agile ceremonies. Analyze product usage, operational data, customer feedback, and support issues to identify trends and improvement opportunities. Create product documentation, workflow diagrams, process flows, release notes, and other product artifacts. Support competitive research and industry analysis related to yard management, logistics, transportation, and supply chain technology. Assist Product Managers in defining product metrics and measuring the success of new features. Work with cross-functional teams to identify gaps in existing workflows and recommend product improvements. Support customer demos, internal product reviews, and release readiness activities. Learn and apply product management practices in an enterprise software environment. Qualifications Required Currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to understand complex workflows and break problems into clear, actionable requirements. Strong attention to detail and an ability to organize and prioritize work. Comfortable working collaboratively with cross-functional teams. Willingness to learn about enterprise software, logistics, and supply chain operations. Basic understanding of Agile/Scrum software development practices. Preferred Pursuing or completed an MBA, preferably with a focus on Product Management, Operations, Technology, or Supply Chain. Previous internship, academic project, or experience related to product management, business analysis, software development, logistics, or operations. Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Excel, Power BI, or similar product/analytics tools. Basic understanding of APIs, software applications, databases, or system integrations. Interest in supply chain, logistics, transportation, warehouse, or yard operations. Experience creating process flows, wireframes, presentations, or product documentation. What You’ll Gain Hands-on experience working as part of an enterprise software product management team. Exposure to the complete product development lifecycle, from problem discovery and requirements definition to development, testing, and release. Practical experience working with Engineering, UX, QA, and other cross-functional teams. Exposure to real-world supply chain and logistics challenges. Mentorship from experienced Product Managers and product leaders. Experience with Agile product development, backlog management, customer requirements, and product analytics. An opportunity to contribute to a product that helps some of the world’s largest organizations improve their supply chain operations. If you are curious about technology, passionate about solving customer problems, and excited to learn how enterprise products are built, we would love to hear from you. Kaleris is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
